subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram spool retry cap fails open when the state DB is corrupt

question: Should confirmed corruption of the shared state database halt only the affected Telegram ingress monitor, or should it enter a gateway-wide state-store recovery mode that blocks every dependent channel until recovery is verified?
rationale: The requested fail-closed behavior is credible, but the scope of the circuit breaker and the operator recovery contract affect multiple channels and shared runtime state.

options.title: Define shared state-store recovery
options.body: Implement a generic ingress circuit breaker for confirmed corruption and expose one operator recovery path before any channel resumes.

options.title: Contain it to Telegram first
options.body: Block only Telegram ingress on confirmed corruption while separately designing a cross-channel state-store policy.

recommendation.title: Define shared state-store recovery
recommendation.body: Implement a generic ingress circuit breaker for confirmed corruption and expose one operator recovery path before any channel resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable individual ownership trail was available; the decision crosses Telegram plugin and shared channel-ingress boundaries.
